title: Altered Topography
physical_identity: Terrain-shifting level documented as two archived states: a low-gravity foggy rainforest at permanent dawn, and an arctic glacier field with luminous reflective ice and a 13-hour day.
scale_topology: Outdoor; extent not stated. Terrain alters itself at unknown intervals; exit position moves each time, destination fixed.
anomalies: reduced gravity for foreign objects/entities only (rainforest state)
Level Key changes with the terrain
glaciers rise and rivers gush from boulders during shifts
lighting_sound: Rainforest: persistent fog, always dawn, 21C. Arctic: luminous reflective ice, about 13 h day-night cycle, 10C to 6C. Sound not stated.

entities.name: Light Guides
entities.behavior: Arctic state: large groups seen, unusual since normally rare and solitary

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Light Guides (arctic state); NO ENTITY PER SOURCE for the rainforest state

entrances.method: Find and touch an orange gallium patch (earlier state: copper-like liquid metal)
entrances.quote: Finding and touching an orange gallium patch in level-75 will bring you here.
There have been several other supposed entrances

exits.method: Rainforest state: climb a sand-covered tree; arctic state: stand on a sand-covered ice sheet
exits.quote: The location of the exit is different with each alteration, but the destination is constant.

signature_mechanic: Two terrain states (rainforest/arctic) swap at unknown intervals preceded by orbs; the only exit always leads to Level 46 but moves to a different prop (sand-covered tree or sand-covered ice).
verticality: Climbable tree in rainforest state; glacier spires in arctic state.
conflicts_notes: Page is two archived entries with survivor comments. State A says no consistent entrance; State B names the gallium patch as the only confirmed one. Level 75 has no link-list slug. Level 15/17 appear in links only as navigation.
